desc.en: Cloth interwoven with animal feathers. Its excellent texture and breathability are unique, and it's also used for underwear and bedding.
desc.ja: 動物の羽根を織り込んだ布。肌触りと通気性の良さが特徴で、インナーや寝具にも使われる

desc.en: Increases transfer PP by 7 when this item is used as a material in Synthesis.
desc.ja: この潜力のついた材料を使って調合すると、引き継ぎＰＰ枠が７増加する

desc.en: Causes armor to increase maximum HP. Effect: Maximum HP increases by 15.
desc.ja: 防具に最大ＨＰを上昇させる効果を付与する。効果：最大ＨＰが１５上昇する

desc.en: Causes armor to enhance defense. Effect: Increases defense by 5.
desc.ja: 防具の防御力を強化する。効果：防御力が５上昇する
